outline: Engineering Mathematics (II) will be divided into four parts: (1)  Fourier analysis, (2) Partial Differential Equations, (3) vector differential and integral calculus.
schedule:
1st    Vector Differential Calculus
2nd   Vector Differential Calculus
3rd   Vector Integral Calculus
4th    Vector Integral Calculus
5th    Vector Integral Calculus s
6th   First Midterm Exam
7th    Matrices and Linear Systems
8th   Determinants
9th    Eigenvalues, Diagonalization, and Special Matrices
10th   Eigenvalues, Diagonalization, and Special Matrices
11th  Second Midterm Exam
12th  Fourier Series, Half-Range Expansions
13th  Fourier Integral
14th  Fourier Integral
15th  Partial Differential Equations: Basic Concepts, Wave Function
16th  Heat Equation: Solution by Separating Variables
17th   Heat Equation: Solution by Separating Variables
18th  Final Exam

1. Present/absent 15%
2. Homework 25% total
3. Midterm, final term 20% each 60% total
